attributes.title: Open workflows, peak (Cloud)
attributes.description: Peak of temporal_cloud_v1_namespace_open_workflows in the selected time range.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_cloud and (prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_namespace_open_workflows.value : *)

attributes.title: Task backlog, peak (Cloud)
attributes.description: Peak in the selected time range of temporal_cloud_v1_approximate_backlog_count across task queues. Sustained > 0 means workers are not keeping up.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_cloud and (prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_approximate_backlog_count.value : *)

attributes.title: Workflow task schedule-to-start p95 (SDK)
attributes.description: p95 over the selected time range. Time a workflow task waits in Temporal Cloud before a worker picks it up.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_workflow_task_schedule_to_start_latency_seconds.histogram : *)

attributes.title: Activity schedule-to-start p95 (SDK)
attributes.description: p95 over the selected time range. Time an activity task waits in Temporal Cloud before a worker picks it up.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_activity_schedule_to_start_latency_seconds.histogram : *)

attributes.title: Min activity slots available (SDK)
attributes.description: Over the selected time range. Lowest free activity-execution slot count across workers. 0 = saturated.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and prometheus.labels.worker_type : ActivityWorker and (prometheus.temporal_worker_task_slots_available.value : *)

attributes.title: Workflow task schedule-to-start p95 by SDK
attributes.description: Cloud→worker latency for workflow tasks (temporal_workflow_task_schedule_to_start_latency). Rising values = add workers/pollers.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_workflow_task_schedule_to_start_latency_seconds.histogram : *) and not prometheus.labels.sdk : "none"

attributes.title: Activity schedule-to-start p95 by SDK
attributes.description: Cloud→worker latency for activity tasks (temporal_activity_schedule_to_start_latency). Rising values = activity slots or pollers exhausted.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_activity_schedule_to_start_latency_seconds.histogram : *) and not prometheus.labels.sdk : "none"

attributes.title: Backlog count by task queue (Cloud)
attributes.description: temporal_cloud_v1_approximate_backlog_count. Cloud data lags ~3 minutes.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_cloud and (prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_approximate_backlog_count.value : *) and not prometheus.labels.temporal_task_queue : "none"

attributes.title: Backlog age by task queue (Cloud)
attributes.description: temporal_cloud_v1_approximate_backlog_age (seconds): age of the oldest waiting task.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_cloud and (prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_approximate_backlog_age.value : *) and not prometheus.labels.temporal_task_queue : "none"

attributes.title: Activity slots available by SDK
attributes.description: temporal_worker_task_slots_available{worker_type=ActivityWorker}, minimum per interval.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and prometheus.labels.worker_type : ActivityWorker and (prometheus.temporal_worker_task_slots_available.value : *) and not prometheus.labels.sdk : "none"

attributes.title: Workflow slots available by SDK
attributes.description: temporal_worker_task_slots_available{worker_type=WorkflowWorker}, minimum per interval.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and prometheus.labels.worker_type : WorkflowWorker and (prometheus.temporal_worker_task_slots_available.value : *) and not prometheus.labels.sdk : "none"

attributes.title: Poll success vs sync match (Cloud)
attributes.description: temporal_cloud_v1_poll_success_count vs poll_success_sync_count (per second). Sync ≈ success means tasks are handed straight to waiting pollers; a widening gap means tasks are queuing.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_cloud and (prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_poll_success_count.value : * or prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_poll_success_sync_count.value : *)

attributes.title: Workflows completed / failed (SDK)
attributes.description: temporal_workflow_completed_total and temporal_workflow_failed_total, count per interval.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_workflow_completed_total.rate : * or prometheus.temporal_workflow_failed_total.rate : *)

attributes.title: Workflow end-to-end p95 by type (SDK)
attributes.description: temporal_workflow_endtoend_latency, p95.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_workflow_endtoend_latency_seconds.histogram : *) and not prometheus.labels.workflow_type : "none"

attributes.title: Activity execution p95 by type (SDK)
attributes.description: temporal_activity_execution_latency, p95 per activity type.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_activity_execution_latency_seconds.histogram : *) and not prometheus.labels.activity_type : "none"

attributes.title: Activity failures by type (SDK)
attributes.description: temporal_activity_execution_failed_total, count per interval (includes attempts that are later retried).

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_activity_execution_failed_total.rate : *) and not prometheus.labels.activity_type : "none"

attributes.title: Requests by operation
attributes.description: temporal_request_total (worker→Cloud gRPC calls), count per interval.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_request_total.rate : *) and not prometheus.labels.operation : "none"

attributes.title: Request failures by operation
attributes.description: temporal_request_failure_total, count per interval.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_request_failure_total.rate : *) and not prometheus.labels.operation : "none"

attributes.title: Request latency p95 by SDK
attributes.description: temporal_request_latency (excludes long polls).

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_request_latency_seconds.histogram : *) and not prometheus.labels.sdk : "none"

attributes.title: Long-poll latency p95 by SDK
attributes.description: temporal_long_request_latency. Long polls near the poll timeout mean workers are idle; short ones mean tasks are waiting.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_long_request_latency_seconds.histogram : *) and not prometheus.labels.sdk : "none"

attributes.title: Workflow task execution p95 by SDK
attributes.description: temporal_workflow_task_execution_latency: time spent running workflow code per task.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_workflow_task_execution_latency_seconds.histogram : *) and not prometheus.labels.sdk : "none"

attributes.title: Workflow task replay p95 by SDK
attributes.description: temporal_workflow_task_replay_latency: grows with history size and cache misses.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_workflow_task_replay_latency_seconds.histogram : *) and not prometheus.labels.sdk : "none"

attributes.title: Workflow task failures
attributes.description: temporal_workflow_task_execution_failed_total (non-determinism, panics, bugs), count per interval.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_workflow_task_execution_failed_total.rate : *) and not prometheus.labels.sdk : "none"

attributes.title: Activity succeeded end-to-end p95 by type
attributes.description: temporal_activity_succeed_endtoend_latency: schedule to final success, including retries.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_activity_succeed_endtoend_latency_seconds.histogram : *) and not prometheus.labels.activity_type : "none"

attributes.title: Slots used by worker type
attributes.description: temporal_worker_task_slots_used, max per interval.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_worker_task_slots_used.value : *) and not prometheus.labels.worker_type : "none"

attributes.title: Pollers by type
attributes.description: temporal_num_pollers, max per interval.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_num_pollers.value : *) and not prometheus.labels.poller_type : "none"

attributes.title: Sticky cache size by SDK
attributes.description: temporal_sticky_cache_size: cached workflow executions.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_sticky_cache_size.value : *) and not prometheus.labels.sdk : "none"

attributes.title: Sticky cache hits / misses
attributes.description: temporal_sticky_cache_hit_total vs temporal_sticky_cache_miss_total, count per interval. Misses force a full replay.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.temporal_sticky_cache_hit_total.rate : * or prometheus.temporal_sticky_cache_miss_total.rate : *)

attributes.title: Java workflow threads
attributes.description: temporal_workflow_active_thread_count (Java only).

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and prometheus.labels.sdk : java and (prometheus.temporal_workflow_active_thread_count.value : *)

attributes.title: Audit writes / failures (sample interceptor)
attributes.description: audit_writes_total and audit_write_failures_total from the T2 audit interceptor, count per interval.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_sdk and (prometheus.audit_writes_total.rate : * or prometheus.audit_write_failures_total.rate : *)

attributes.title: Open workflows over time
attributes.description: temporal_cloud_v1_namespace_open_workflows (gauge).

query.query: source_kind : temporal_cloud and (prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_namespace_open_workflows.value : *)

attributes.title: Workflow success /s by type
attributes.description: temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_success_count (per-second rate, 1-min average).

query.query: source_kind : temporal_cloud and (prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_success_count.value : *) and not prometheus.labels.temporal_workflow_type : "none"

attributes.title: Workflow failed / timed out / terminated /s
attributes.description: temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_failed_count, workflow_timeout_count, workflow_terminate_count.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_cloud and (prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_failed_count.value : * or prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_timeout_count.value : * or prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_terminate_count.value : *)

attributes.title: Workflow schedule-to-close p95 by type
attributes.description: temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_schedule_to_close_latency_p95 (precomputed by Cloud; do not re-aggregate).

query.query: source_kind : temporal_cloud and (prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_schedule_to_close_latency_p95.value : *) and not prometheus.labels.temporal_workflow_type : "none"

attributes.title: Activity success / fail /s
attributes.description: temporal_cloud_v1_activity_success_count and activity_fail_count.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_cloud and (prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_success_count.value : * or prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_fail_count.value : *)

attributes.title: Activity start-to-close p95 by type
attributes.description: temporal_cloud_v1_activity_start_to_close_latency_p95 (needs labels=temporal_activity_type in the scrape).

query.query: source_kind : temporal_cloud and (prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_start_to_close_latency_p95.value : *) and not prometheus.labels.temporal_activity_type : "none"

attributes.title: Polls: success, timeout, no-poller tasks
attributes.description: temporal_cloud_v1_poll_success_count, poll_timeout_count, no_poller_tasks_count. no_poller_tasks > 0 means tasks arrived with no worker polling.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_cloud and (prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_poll_success_count.value : * or prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_poll_timeout_count.value : * or prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_no_poller_tasks_count.value : *)

attributes.title: Service requests /s by operation
attributes.description: temporal_cloud_v1_service_request_count.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_cloud and (prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_service_request_count.value : *) and not prometheus.labels.operation : "none"

attributes.title: Service errors /s by operation
attributes.description: temporal_cloud_v1_service_error_count.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_cloud and (prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_service_error_count.value : *) and not prometheus.labels.operation : "none"

attributes.title: Service latency p95 by operation
attributes.description: temporal_cloud_v1_service_latency_p95.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_cloud and (prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_service_latency_p95.value : *) and not prometheus.labels.operation : "none"

attributes.title: Throttling
attributes.description: temporal_cloud_v1_service_request_throttled_count, resource_exhausted_error_count, total_action_throttled_count (per second). Anything non-zero needs attention.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_cloud and (prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_service_request_throttled_count.value : * or prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_resource_exhausted_error_count.value : * or prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_total_action_throttled_count.value : *)

attributes.title: Actions /s vs limit
attributes.description: temporal_cloud_v1_total_action_count vs action_limit (actions per second).

query.query: source_kind : temporal_cloud and (prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_total_action_count.value : * or prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_action_limit.value : *)

attributes.title: Requests /s vs limit
attributes.description: Sum of temporal_cloud_v1_service_request_count across operations vs service_request_limit.

query.query: source_kind : temporal_cloud and (prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_service_request_count.value : * or prometheus.temporal_cloud_v1_service_request_limit.value : *)

attributes.title: Temporal · Worker capacity overview
attributes.description: Is the worker fleet keeping up? Cloud backlog + SDK schedule-to-start latency + slot usage, Java and Python side by side.

attributes.title: Temporal · SDK workers (Java + Python)
attributes.description: Worker-side SDK metrics scraped from each worker's /metrics endpoint. Mirrors the panels of Temporal's reference SDK dashboard.

attributes.title: Temporal · Cloud namespace health
attributes.description: Temporal Cloud OpenMetrics (metrics.temporal.io/v1/metrics). All series are gauges; *_count are per-second rates averaged per minute; data lags ~3 minutes.
